name: label
description: The `aria-label` for the navigation landmark. Defaults to `"Section navigation"`. Use this to provide a meaningful label if multiple navigation landmarks are present on the page. Ignored if `labelledBy` is set.

name: labelledBy
description: The `id` of an element to use as the accessible label for the navigation via `aria-labelledby`. Takes precedence over `label`.

params.name: text
params.description: Text for the navigation item. If `html` is provided, `text` is ignored.

params.name: html
params.description: HTML for the navigation item. If `html` is provided, `text` is ignored.

params.name: href
params.description: The `href` for the navigation item link. If omitted, the item is rendered as a `<span>` instead of an `<a>`.

params.name: current
params.description: If `true`, marks this item as the current page using `aria-current="page"` and wraps the item text in a `<strong>` element as a visual fallback.

params.name: badge
params.description: Optional badge to display alongside the item text, for example a count or status label. Accepts the same params as the badge component.

params.name: classes
params.description: Classes to add to the list item.

params.name: attributes
params.description: HTML attributes (for example data attributes) to add to the list item.

name: classes
description: Classes to add to the navigation element. Use `"nhsuk-section-navigation--reverse"` for use on coloured backgrounds.

name: vertical
description: If `true`, forces the navigation to remain stacked vertically at all breakpoints, rather than switching to a horizontal layout at tablet width.

name: attributes
description: HTML attributes (for example data attributes) to add to the navigation element.
